info.cls_ename: Ph.D. Program, Department of Industrial Engineering and Systems Management

description.describe_ch: 訓練學生學習創新性研究，學生必須選擇一位指導教授針對研究問題進行研究發展和設計，然後撰寫研究論文和研究的結果。論文需含研究專題導論、文獻回顧、研究設計、研究結果和結論。
description.describe_eh: The course will teach and conduct an original empirical research study. The student must choose a faculty member as a primary advisor to work with. The student must to develop a research project to collect and analyze data and to investigate the research question. The study results are then written up in a thesis. The thesis typically contains an introductory chapter outlining the research question, a literature review chapter, a chapter describing the research design and a chapter discussing results, and stating conclusions, and making recommendations for future research.
